title: VPN Gateway and Azure CDN
description: Connect on-premises networks to Azure with VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute, and deliver content faster with Azure CDN.

data.text: So far, the networks we have discussed live inside Azure. But most companies already have networks on-premises. Azure provides two main ways to connect those worlds together: VPN Gateway for encrypted tunnels over the internet, and ExpressRoute for a private, dedicated connection through a telecom provider.

A VPN Gateway is a virtual network gateway that sends encrypted traffic between your Azure VNet and your on-premises location over the public internet. You create the gateway in a dedicated gateway subnet inside your VNet. Azure supports both policy-based and route-based VPNs, with route-based being the most common choice.

data.title: VPN Gateway connections
items: **Site-to-site**: Links an entire on-premises network to Azure
**Point-to-site**: Links individual client computers to Azure
**Route-based VPN**: Most common, supports dynamic routing with BGP

data.text: ExpressRoute provides a private connection to Azure services through a connectivity provider, rather than the public internet. This gives you more reliability, faster speeds, and lower latency. It is commonly used for large enterprises with strict data-privacy requirements or heavy data-transfer needs.

Azure Content Delivery Network, or CDN, is a distributed network of servers that caches content closer to users. When someone requests a file from your website, the CDN serves it from the nearest edge location, reducing latency and improving load times for users around the world.

data.title: Create a CDN profile and endpoint using Azure CLI
data.content: Azure CLI to create a CDN profile and endpoint
data.code:
az cdn profile create \
  --name MyCdnProfile \
  --resource-group MyResourceGroup \
  --sku Standard_Microsoft

az cdn endpoint create \
  --name MyCdnEndpoint \
  --profile-name MyCdnProfile \
  --resource-group MyResourceGroup \
  --origin www.contoso.com \
  --origin-host-header www.contoso.com

items.question: What is the difference between VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute?
items.answer: VPN Gateway uses the public internet with encryption, while ExpressRoute uses a private provider connection without traversing the public internet.

items.question: Does Azure CDN cache dynamic content?
items.answer: CDN is best for static content like images, scripts, and stylesheets. Dynamic content can be cached with rules, but it is not the default behavior.

items.question: Can I use both VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute at the same time?
items.answer: Yes. You can configure a site-to-site VPN as a failover path when ExpressRoute has an outage.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: VPN Gateway connects on-premises networks over the internet.
ExpressRoute provides a private, high-throughput connection.
Azure CDN caches static content at edge locations near users.
You can use VPN as a backup for ExpressRoute.
data.takeaway: Hybrid connectivity lets your on-premises network and Azure work as one environment.
